Repository Structure

The Mensabot project is organized as a ROS 2 workspace.

Main Directories

  • src/ – ROS 2 packages

  • docs/ – Sphinx and Doxygen documentation

  • arduino_code/ – Arduino firmware

  • scripts/ – Utility scripts

Each ROS 2 package is responsible for a dedicated part of the software architecture and can be developed independently.
